messages:
priya: Opening a docs PR for an offline CA rotation flow for HSM-backed KMS in Private deployments. Draft branch: docs/offline-ca-rollout. Need a concise checklist, exact offline signing commands, an example systemd unit to install certs on nodes, and a short migration note for v1.2 -> v1.3. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432

ben: thanks — can you include step-by-step for creating an intermediate CA and signing CSRs offline? Ops will also need notes about firewall rules for airgapped installs (nftables vs iptables).

priya: added a draft snippet below, posting for review:
```bash
# generate node private key
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out node.key -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072
# create CSR
openssl req -new -key node.key -subj "/CN=kms-node1.redwood.local" -out node.csr
# offline sign on an isolated signing host
openssl x509 -req -in node.csr -CA ca.pem -CAkey ca.key -CAcreateserial -out node.crt -days 3650 -sha256
```

laura: looks good. Please add an example for importing the private key into an HSM (PKCS#11). Vendor flags differ but an example helps ops: 
```bash
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libp11.so --login --pin 1234 --write-object node.key --type privkey --label "kms-node1"
```
Add a note: "flags vary by HSM vendor; confirm with vendor SDK."

sam: also add a systemd unit for atomic cert install + agent restart, e.g.:
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Install KMS cert and restart agent
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/install-kms-cert.sh /tmp/node.crt /tmp/node.key
RemainAfterExit=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
And mention the install script should verify signature, set ownership to redis:kms (or redwood-kms) and 0600 perms.

priya: adding verification and restart steps to the checklist:
```bash
# verify certificate chain
openssl verify -CAfile ca.pem node.crt
# install -> then restart agent
systemctl restart redwood-kms-agent
journalctl -u redwood-kms-agent -f --since "5m"
```

ben: please include rollback steps if import fails (restore previous key/cert from offline backup, restart agent). Also include HSM key-handle mapping notes and how to retrieve labels via pkcs11-tool. Requesting security review: @security.

docs-bot: Reminder: run docs/linkcheck workflow (docs/linkcheck) and the staging build (docs/build) before merging.

priya: tagging reviewers @laura @ben @security. Also planning a short migration guide for the v1.2 -> v1.3 docs site (backport patch). @sam do we need a release-note?

sam: yes, add release-note: "Private deploy: offline CA rotation for HSM-backed KMS — step-by-step checklist and caveats". Also add an offline e2e test matrix: three-node cert rollout, HSM import verification, agent restart, and failure/rollback case.

laura: tiny nit: use lowercase file names in examples (ca.key, ca.pem) for consistency, and link to PKCS#11 spec and common vendor pages. Also mention time sync requirement for cert validity checks (chrony/ntp) in airgapped installs.

priya: fixed the nits and pushed an update to the PR. I added a short note on time sync and a vendor caveats section. Will wait for security ack before merging. Thanks all :raised_hands:
